what: While the section stays pinned and scrolls photo count × 100%, only the photo in the cell given by progress divided by photo count (floor(progress × count)) is on. When the cell changes, the previous photo fades out overlapping in .8s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1) and the next appears (only cell picking is tied to scroll). The side text stays put

options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Frame (child) for stacking images — size and corners are set by the consuming css
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Stacked photos (children inside the frame) — the first photo is on at the start
options.per: Scroll used per photo (% of screen height), default 100
options.start: Pin start (ScrollTrigger start), default ”top top” — with a floating header band use something like ”top 88px”
options.from: Minimum window width to turn on (px), default 768 — if narrower, keep only the first photo
options.priority: ScrollTrigger refreshPriority, default 0 — if you created triggers on elements below this pinned section first (such as the header band color change), raise it so the pinned section is calculated first (original 3)
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Progress bars (optional children, several) — the bar count divides the range into slots, and each bar fills 0→100% in height over its own slot. Bar frame and color come from the consumer’s css (brand 3×84px)

note: The pin is a ScrollTrigger pin, so the space grows by section height + photo count × per%. The original starts the pin at the header bar height (top 88px)

from.where: index.html .km-about (original [data-top-about] — three vertical photos · start top <Header Height>px · end +=count×100% · .top-about__figure__item.is-active .8s)
index.html .ft (Features — original script-index-feature: a 300vh panel pinned with sticky, items cross-swap per share at .3s ease-in-out · the two left bars fill by each cell’s share)
